description: This file implements the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal class and related factory functions for managing Web Audio playback, including shared memory buffer management, threading, and interaction with GStreamer for media playback.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
classes.description: Implementation of the internal Web Audio Player server handling media buffer management, playback control, and threading.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating WebAudioPlayerServerInternal instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory for WebAudioPlayerServerInternal.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a WebAudioPlayer instance (not used directly in server context).

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Creates an internal WebAudioPlayer object with shared memory and threading support.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebAudioPlayerServerInternal with configuration, shared memory, and threading factories.

methods.name: initWebAudioPlayerInternal
methods.description: Initializes shared memory mapping and GStreamer WebAudio player.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback via GStreamer.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback via GStreamer.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream condition.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer info and frames.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Calculates delay in frames based on queued bytes.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes frames to shared memory and GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: writeBufferInternal
methods.description: Handles the actual buffer writing logic, including wrapping and timer management.

methods.name: writeStoredBuffers
methods.description: Writes stored buffer data to GStreamer, handling wrap-around cases.

methods.name: updateAvailableBuffer
methods.description: Updates buffer offsets and lengths after writing data.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Provides device info such as preferred and maximum frames.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client interface.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Notifies client of state changes.

methods.name: initGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Initializes the GStreamer WebAudio player.

methods.name: handleWriteDataTimer
methods.description: Timer callback to handle periodic buffer writing.

methods.name: getQueuedFramesInShm
methods.description: Calculates the number of queued frames in shared memory.
